definitions.explanation: Growing in power or popularity as irresistibly as the rising sun; said of a person, company or movement on the way up.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}の{出|で}の{勢|いきお}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧、{日|ひ}の{出|で}の{勢|いきお}いだ。
examples.english: That company is rising fast right now.

examples.japanese: ⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日|ひ}の{出|で}の{勢|いきお}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: A year after her debut, her popularity is soaring.

notes:
Used of someone still climbing; for someone already at the top, the phrase is ⟦{飛|と}ぶ{鳥|とり}を{落|お}とす{勢|いきお}い→飛ぶ鳥を落とす勢い：34019_tobutoriwootosuikioi⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {日|ひ}の{出|で}の{勢|いきお}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: a ... on the rise
- {日|ひ}の{出|で}の{勢|いきお}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ + verb: rapidly, irresistibly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{破竹|はちく}の{勢|いきお}い→破竹の勢い：34028_hachikunoikioi⟧: unstoppable momentum, winning streak after streak
- ⟦{飛|と}ぶ{鳥|とり}を{落|お}とす{勢|いきお}い→飛ぶ鳥を落とす勢い：34019_tobutoriwootosuikioi⟧: at the height of one's power
